reasons.plausibility: This hypothesis aligns with well-established principles of kinetic versus thermodynamic control in alloy solidification, though it relies on uncertain thresholds for diffusion rates and specific element interactions.
reasons.testability: It proposes a clear control versus intervention experiment and outlines conclusive characterization methods (XRD, TEM/EDS, DSC) to verify or refute the predicted phase changes.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a direct path to investigate how cooling rates affect phase stability in multi-principal noble metal alloys, offering actionable insights for material synthesis strategies.
